tickerText: [TENNIS] Alex Eala rallied past Olympic champion Zheng Qinwen 4-6, 6-4, 6-1 at the Mubadala DC Open and will face defending champion Leylah Fernandez, while Cruz Hewitt notched his first ATP Tour win • [SQUASH] The Victorian Open 2026 gets underway in Melbourne as the PSA circuit shifts to Australia, with the Dallas Squash Challenger following in Plano from July 30 • [BADMINTON] Main-draw action opens at the HSBC BWF Taipei Open with Lee Zii Jia, Justin Hoh, and Eogene Ewe among the headline names • [PICKLEBALL] Hong Kit Wong climbed to a career-best PPA world No. 10 after winning his third straight Singapore Open singles title • [TABLE TENNIS] Attention turns to WTT Champions Yokohama starting August 4 after Hugo Calderano edged Alexis Lebrun 4-3 in the São José dos Campos final

newsItems.title: Victorian Open Kicks Off
newsItems.excerpt: The PSA Victorian Open 2026 begins in Melbourne today, opening a busy Australasian stretch before the Dallas Squash Challenger starts in Plano on July 30.

newsItems.title: Taipei Open Main Draw Opens
newsItems.excerpt: The HSBC BWF Taipei Open Super 300 is underway at Taipei Arena, with Lee Zii Jia, Justin Hoh, and Eogene Ewe leading a packed main-draw field.

newsItems.title: Wong Breaks Into PPA Top 10
newsItems.excerpt: Hong Kong's Hong Kit Wong rose to a career-best world No. 10 after capturing his third consecutive men's singles title at the PPA Tour Asia Singapore Open.

newsItems.title: Yokohama Champions Next Up
newsItems.excerpt: The WTT circuit moves on to Champions Yokohama on August 4 after Hugo Calderano outlasted Alexis Lebrun 4-3 to win the Star Contender in São José dos Campos.
